analysis:
The PR adds three optional diagnostic fields to DaemonState: enabledModelsAtStart, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch and selectedModelRecovery. The changes are in DaemonStateFile.swift (property declarations and init, patch hunks near lines 54-70, 346-350 and 384-388) and DaemonState+Coding.swift (CodingKeys, init(from:) and encode(to:) at head lines 13-15, 37-41 and 78-82). All three are decoded with decodeIfPresent and encoded with encodeIfPresent. Schema stays 1 and old files still decode. The existing autopilotState/autopilot compatibility handling is unchanged.

No security regression found. The new fields hold model identifiers, config filter lists and recovery status. They are not prompts, keys, attestation material, tokens or authorization evidence (A-001, A-003, A-010, A-015, A-016 untouched). The state file is a diagnostic written by the daemon and read by status, doctor and the watchdog. The file is outside the coordinator wire boundary TB-002, so this PR does not change that boundary.

Remaining unverified points: (1) the definition of SelectedModelRecoveryEntry is not in the supplied evidence. Its fields, such as the blocked-reason text, could include paths or error strings. That is a minor local disclosure to the same-user status readers and cannot be assessed here. (2) DaemonStateFile.write does not set explicit permissions and uses default atomic writes. That is pre-existing and unchanged. (3) The consumers of the new fields (status/doctor comparison logic) are not in this batch. If any consumer used them for trust or authorization decisions it would need review, but nothing here suggests that. No T-041 cache behavior is touched.
